name: Higuera de Albalat (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Higuera de Albalat (a fig leaf on white).
history: Municipal flag of Higuera de Albalat; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Higuera de Albalat arms — fig leaf on white
